label: Caltopo Proxy
info:
Generic server-side CalTopo proxy for the CloudTAK plugin.

Why: the browser cannot call caltopo.com directly (CalTopo sends no CORS
headers, so the cross-origin fetch is blocked). This tab exposes ONE
endpoint the plugin can call; Node-RED signs (HMAC-SHA256) and forwards the
request to CalTopo server-to-server, then returns the response with CORS
headers.

The endpoint lives under the /sync/ prefix so it rides the same reverse-proxy
route the existing bridge (/sync/run, /sync/health, ...) already uses.

Endpoint:
  POST /sync/caltopo   body: {
                    method:        'POST' | 'GET',          // default POST
                    endpoint:      '/api/v1/acct/' | '/api/v1/map/...' ,
                    accountId:     '<team/account id>',       // for /acct/ endpoints
                    mapID:         '<map id>',                // for map endpoints
                    uuid:          '<feature id>',            // optional (PUT/update)
                    since:         <number>,                  // optional, GET since/<n>
                    payload:       { ...GeoJSON/CalTopo body },// for POST
                    credentialId:  '...', credentialKey: '...' // optional; env fallback
                  }
  OPTIONS /sync/caltopo  -> 204 preflight

Credentials resolve from the request body first, then env vars
(credentialId/credentialKey/accountId, or CALTOPO_CREDENTIAL_ID/
CALTOPO_CREDENTIAL_KEY/CALTOPO_ACCOUNT_ID).

This is intentionally generic so the same endpoint serves every CalTopo
request type (create map, since-polling, feature create/update, etc.).
